title: crash_instinct — plan 1 (0,0 → 3,2 s)
notes: Reproduction de la vidéo de CB « The Instinct That Makes You Crash » (CB est l'auteur). Analyse : references/crash_instinct/shots/s01.md. Temps relatifs au début de la vidéo (image 0 = 0 s). kind=fragment : les contrôles STORY de la vidéo entière ne font qu'avertir. Débit : la phrase se termine à 3,96 s, dans le plan 2 (15 mots sur 3,2 s ici = 4,69 mots/s ; sur la vidéo entière 3,67 mots/s, mesuré).

shots.narration: If you plant a tree beside an empty road, cars will steer right into it.
shots.transition_in: start of the video (first image shows the action at once: seed in hand)

camera.move: fast pull-back and slide onto the road
settle low on the road, whole tree in frame

actions.what: holds the acorn up proudly, tiny toss in the hand
reactions: the acorn rises and falls in the hand
the face changes ON the word 'plant' with a 5-frame head pop
the body answers the face: chest out, shoulders up
consequences: acorn stays in the right hand until the drop

actions.what: bends and drops the acorn into the hole
actions.anim: m:inspect/B (squat, hands low; lift/B raised the arms: PI-018); seed follows the drawn hand (card_anchors) then falls
reactions: falls with gravity into the hole
dust puff on contact: a little earth splashes up
consequences: the seed stays in the hole, covered by earth

actions.what: a full-grown oak falls from the sky, roots first, into the hole
actions.anim: keyed fall from z=+14 m, accelerating, slight tilt
reactions: falls with gravity, settles upright with a crown sway
dust puff on contact: big brown ring, clods thrown, grass flattened
consequences: object stays where it lands: the tree stands planted in the hole
tree planted for the rest of the film, roots buried, ring of turned earth and clods around the trunk

actions.what: round eyes, arms up, on the word 'tree'
reactions: the face changes on the word with a 5-frame head pop
the body leans back, shoulders up

actions.what: the impact blast throws him back; he lands sitting in the grass
actions.anim: m:sit/A@0.7 from frame 24 (the plop lands at 30-36); card thrown on a keyed arc 1.2 m back and sunk 0.30 m into a tall grass tuft that hides the drawing's seat
reactions: anticipation, impact, body falls with arms out, bounce, dust
consequences: sits on the ground beside the tree for the rest of the shot

actions.what: the white car drives down the empty road toward camera
actions.anim: keyed path along the lane, 60 km/h, wheel spin = distance / radius
reactions: wheels turn at the ground speed, suspension bob
heat shimmer and faint dust trail behind it
consequences: tyre tracks on soft ground where it leaves the road

actions.what: steers off the lane straight toward the tree, bites the shoulder
actions.anim: yaw 18 deg toward the trunk, front wheels turned
reactions: gravel and grass thrown by the wheels
consequences: tyre tracks in the grass of the shoulder

state_changes.change: enters from the top of the frame -> planted
far on the road -> on the shoulder heading for the tree

fx: dust behind the car on the shoulder

sound.music: light bed, about -7.6 dB under the voice

captions.style: white bold rounded, thick black outline, centred at 70 % height, one change per word

hook.action: the planter shows the acorn, drops it, and a full-grown tree falls from the sky into the hole
